locator.section: The Most Holy Name of Jesus, Introit

entries.claim: Historical English basis of the antiphon, the verse and the repeated antiphon, revised against the Latin in contemporary language: At the name renders in nómine of Phil 2:10, of those in heaven and in all the earth are revised, and the address is modernized. This page prints only Glory, &c. for the doxology.

locator.section: Ordinary of the Mass, Gloria Patri at the psalm Iudica

entries.claim: Only w035–w054 inherit the familiar Gloria Patri, with Holy Spirit for printed Holy Ghost; world without end is retained in this traditional formula. The surrounding antiphon, verse and repetition are not attributed to this page.
